components.name: EMA Gram matrices left_gram (m x m, GG^T) and right_gram (n x n, G^T G)
components.applies_to: all 72 hidden matrices: 2 x 768x768 per attention matrix, 3072x3072 + 768x768 per MLP matrix

aux_note: AdamW m and v on embedding, LM head and 1-D params
notes: The Grams are fp32; the eigenbases U, V come from a fresh torch.linalg.eigh every step and are local variables, so they are temporaries, not state. The NorMuon postconditioner's second_momentum ((m,1)/(1,n)) is O(rows+cols) and ignored.
evidence: SinkSOAP.step: state["left_gram"] = torch.zeros((m, m), dtype=float32); state["right_gram"] = torch.zeros((n, n), dtype=float32)
gram_sinkhorn_normuon_update: U = gram_eigenbasis(left_gram); V = gram_eigenbasis(right_gram) -- recomputed, not stored
SinkSOAP.step: state["second_momentum"] = torch.zeros((m, 1)) or ((1, n)) -- row/col vector, ignored
optimizer1 = AdamW([embed.weight, proj.weight, 1-D params], fused=True): exp_avg + exp_avg_sq per param
